thread:
marc: quick sync - we plan to enable `route-split-llm-mux-v3` tonight in the 22:30 UTC change window. want ops + prod eyeballs.
jia: oncall for that window, ping me. what's the safety posture?
lena: can we start in shadow mode first? run traffic mirrored to v3 but only collect signals for 1h before any live ramp.
marc: yes shadow for 60m, then staged enable: 0 -> 0.5% -> 3% -> 10% -> 100%. Each gate has an auto-pause if any threshold is hit.
ops-bot: Shadow mirror scheduled at 2026-03-21T22:30:00Z. Metrics tracked: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, model-bleu, and tail CPU.
jia: thresholds to trip auto-pause? share exact numbers so I can script alerts.
lena: propose: 5xx > 0.8% OR p95 increase >25% OR model-bleu drop >5 points over baseline window (15m). If any triggered for 3m continuous -> auto-pause and pin back to previous flag state.
marc: also pin the canary cohort to model binary v3.1.0 and warm caches ahead of mirror start. don't co-locate canary with nightly batch jobs.
jia: escape hatch commands (put in runbook): 
`# quick revert to baseline`
`curl -XPOST "https://deploy.internal/api/flags/route-split-llm-mux-v3/revert" -d '{"percent":0}'`
`# drain canary pool`
`ssh ops@control -C "deployctl cohort drain --flag route-split-llm-mux-v3 --cohort=canary"`
lena: I'll attach a short trace sampling query at each gate so we can review context windows. manual approval required at 3% and 10% gates.
deploy-bot: Shadow mirror started at 5987660200. Mirroring traffic to v3.1.0; no live routing yet. Telemetry hooks engaged.
jia: initial shadow metrics look clean at 20m in. p50 +3%, p95 +8%, 5xx 0.05%, bleu delta -1. moving to 0.5% in 10m for a brief soak.
marc: setting deploy-bot to bump to 0.5% at 5987660800 then pause for 10m. Oncall will confirm before 3% bump.
ops-bot: Pre-warm check: KV hit rate on pinned pool > 92% ? true. No heavy batch jobs detected on nodes.
lena: reminding product to snapshot eval set now and again before 3% gate. we want a before/after diff.
jia: will watch dashboards and keep a 15min cadence updates here. if anything smells off we hit the revert.
marc: thanks. i'll update release notes: "route-split-llm-mux-v3: shadowed 60m -> staged ramp with safety pauses; pinned v3.1.0 for canary; autosafety: 5xx>0.8% | p95>25% | bleu<-5pts -> pause+revert."
deploy-bot: Bump executed: set to 0.5% at 5987660800. Paused for 10m soak. Manual approval required to proceed to 3%.
